draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: Canonical serialisation of the proposal artifact uses recursive sorted keys with no whitespace, producing proposal_canon.json as the exact bytes to be hashed. A third party re-derives hProposal by computing sha256(proposal_canon.json), then re-derives the seed by computing sha256(hProposal || salt) where salt = 66f0719ad1120342bf2890a51e0609180f26910085c2790a0cd5d3f74d9ab233 and || denotes concatenation. The draw rule is deterministic: all 95 witnesses from census.json are drawn in order, without replacement, exhausting the witness bank. This procedure ensures the proposer cannot have tuned to the witnesses and the prover cannot be accused of choosing them.
